hebrewText: נִדְמ֥וּ עַמִּ֖/י מִ/בְּלִ֣י הַ/דָּ֑עַת כִּֽי אַתָּ֞ה הַ/דַּ֣עַת מָאַ֗סְתָּ וְ/אֶמְאָֽסְא/ךָ֙ מִ/כַּהֵ֣ן לִ֔/י וַ/תִּשְׁכַּח֙ תּוֹרַ֣ת אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ אֶשְׁכַּ֥ח בָּנֶ֖י/ךָ גַּם אָֽנִי

tokens.bdb: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
properly, failure, i.e. nothing or destruction; usually (with preposition) without, not yet, because not, as long as, etc.
tokens.kjv: corruption, ig(norantly), for lack of, where no...is, so that no, none, not, un(awares), without.
